policies.intent: Repeated ordinary taps to cut next targets and maintain travel.
More frequent ordinary taps to attempt higher traversal/avoidance.
Less frequent taps to observe landing/contact and attributable failure.
Observe initial pause and varying timing, recovery and renewed cutting.

input: Real touch/mouse center at50%width/45%height. No state hooks, game source, fixtures or game API. Fixed policies frozen before candidate navigation. Playwright continuously records video.
terminalPolicy: At each scheduled action, click an actually visible role=button whose visible name indicates replay/retry; wait150ms, then normal play input. No hidden telemetry.
limitations: Controller-authored input schedules, not an autonomous learned/visual play policy; independent subject judges recorded visible outcomes.
Cadence variation is an acquisition strategy, not a gameplay acceptance rule or copied balancing. No claim that failure under a given cadence is a defect.
Fixed40sec may not reach all branches. Unreached/ambiguous branches UNOBSERVED. No extra sessions after freeze.
No mobile landscape in this limited12-case protocol; no platform package proof.
